text: 55 years of audio aggregate nobody has ever done this at number 3. 13000 runs. Viratkoli is the first ever.

The record used to belong to Ricky Ponting 12,662 runs in 330 innings. Kohli went past in 251. Ponting averaged 42 at No. 3. Kohli averages over 61. Ponting made 2900s where Kohli has 48. Sangakkara, Kalyi, Williams, so nobody else is even close. And he did all of it a day before his 38th birthday. So is Virat the greatest No. 3 of all time? Tell me in the comments and follow for more.
